pkgmetadata.longdescription: CodeGraph builds a local, pre-indexed knowledge graph of a codebase (symbols, call paths, dependents) with tree-sitter and keeps it in sync as the code changes. It exposes the graph through a CLI and an MCP server so AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor or OpenCode can answer structural questions with fewer tokens and tool calls. This package installs the self-contained upstream release bundle, which ships its own Node.js runtime.
